title: Jira Review (2026)
intro: Jira is evaluated here as an engineering / Agile issue tracker — Jira is the default engineering / Agile work tracker for sprints, backlogs, workflows and DevOps integrations. Free covers up to 10 users; Standard ~$8.15/user/mo annual; Premium ~$16; Enterprise custom. Best for software orgs — not a general marketing Work OS peer on undifferentiated ranks. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Jira when software delivery, sprints and DevOps integration are the primary job — landscape on general Work OS lists.
verdict: Choose Jira when software delivery, sprints and DevOps integration are the primary job — landscape on general Work OS lists. Compare Linear for a modern eng UX, ClickUp/Asana for cross-functional Work OS, and Trello for lightweight boards. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Steep for non-engineers — admin/workflow complexity is the classic Jira trade-off.
Best-in-class for sprints, backlogs, epics and issue workflows for software delivery.
Powerful automation rules; often needs admin skill to keep healthy.
Issue comments strong; docs collaboration usually pairs with Confluence — held at 6 for PM-suite comparison.
Deep DevOps + Atlassian ecosystem (Bitbucket, Confluence, GitHub/GitLab).
Dashboards, velocity and advanced roadmaps (Premium+) serve eng managers well.
Proven at enterprise software-org scale — top scalability score in this set.
Free ≤10 and ~$8 Standard floors are strong for eng teams. Affiliate economics excluded.
Atlassian Intelligence exists as add-on/bundle — not the product’s centre of gravity vs Motion/ClickUp Brain.

limitations: Confluence often required for wiki/docs depth
Premium features gated for advanced roadmaps/storage
Not a marketing Work OS peer on undifferentiated ranks

faq.question: Is Jira a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. Jira is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is Jira priced?
faq.answer: Free ≤10 users; Standard ~$8.15, Premium ~$16 per user/mo annual; Enterprise custom. Confirm live Atlassian list.

faq.question: Does Jira have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: Yes — a free plan is published. A free trial is documented. Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Jira?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
